objective: Find what Billion Context (github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context) writes into ~/.claude when 'bili plugin install claude' runs: the exact content or a distinctive line of commands/acp-cache.md, the hook it adds (claude-native-bootstrap) and its command, the MCP server entry, and the settings env keys.
scope: Read the project's source and docs on GitHub (repository ranxianglei/billion-context, its npm package billion-context) with the available web tools; quote exact strings with file paths and commit or version.

Use: holyagent setup claude removes these leftovers and must match only what Billion Context wrote; it currently guesses a marker for acp-cache.md from the words billion-context, bili or claude-native-bootstrap.

criteria.text: Each of the four items is quoted from a cited source with path and version, or stated as not found
